name: physics_rope
purpose: kin/physics3d's ropes (P2e): chains of capsules with ball joints (Rope3D, drawn as tubes), on a recipe in tools/reference/kin_reference.cpp (PhysicsRope): a bridge of three ropes between two posts with a box on it between low walls; a rope hung from a beam 25 degrees out from the vertical with the skinned person under its end, who takes hold with both hands (frame 10), climbs (240 to 420) and lets go with a jump off (560); and a rope that a winch reels in (from frame 120) with a 15 kg crate on its end. The hands are on the rope by IK. Fixed step, no Cycles truth: the check is that two runs give the same picture byte for byte.
